campaigns.rationale: Shopping is how ecommerce sells, but the three existing Shopping campaigns burned $1,686/mo for zero recorded conversions. Restarting as ONE measured tier instead of three, at a fraction of prior spend, until it proves itself.

campaigns.name: BP RT · Display Remarketing
campaigns.rationale: RETAINED, not rebuilt. Existing BP RT 2 delivers the best CPA in the account -- 7 conversions at $21 on just $147/mo. It was budget-starved at $5/day; this is a modest increase.

campaigns.name: BP · PMax — Retail Feed
campaigns.rationale: Retail PMax linked to the live Merchant Center feed (101451631) so product ads route to real product page URLs. Four asset groups filtered by actual feed product types, covering 778 of 894 eligible SKUs.

landing_page_policy.rule: ADS POINT AT PRODUCT PAGES ONLY. Collection pages are reserved for organic traffic.
landing_page_policy.reason: Trevor's direction based on account experience -- collection pages convert poorly on paid. Consistent with the catalog: hero products run $2.8k-$10k, so a product page with price, specs and a quote/financing CTA outperforms a grid that creates choice paralysis.
landing_page_policy.shopping_and_pmax: No action needed. Retail Shopping and PMax product ads pull destination URLs from the Merchant Center feed automatically, which already resolve to product pages.
landing_page_policy.search_skags: Each SKAG points at the hero product for its term, selected below from live feed data.
landing_page_policy.selection_method: Filtered by brand AND product_type together, then took the median-priced item. Filtering by brand alone surfaced accessories -- the cheapest 'blaze' item is an insulated jacket and the cheapest 'coyote' is a pull-out drawer. Sending a grill searcher to a grill cover would fail silently.
landing_page_policy.blocker: The Google Ads API exposes shopping_product.item_id but NO product URL field. betterpatio.com is blocked by this environment's network policy, and the Shopify connector is authorized to Trevor's own store, not BetterPatio. Product page URLs must come from Trevor.
